notes.title: First Playtest!
notes.content:
The first playtest has begun!

Thank you all for following Barda! We have randomly picked 60 players to have an exclusive peek at a very early build of the game: 0.2.1

It features the very basic fundations of the game: 

 Our 2D physics-based bag
 A first version of a randomly generated mountain to climb
 75 items, alhtough many of them are still roughly drawn
 Exclusive preview of our new Volcano biome


We're looking at any useful feedback or ideas you can give us, either here on Steam or over at our discord server: https://discord.gg/kAQXzQJMGm

If you want to be part of Barda development, sign in for our future sessions!

Enjoy!
